policy: References informed proportions, appendage layout and colour placement only. No pixels were sampled, traced, copied or redistributed. Seller imagery was not used as a texture or tracing source. A user-supplied side-profile photograph was consulted for proportion only (body depth, snout length, eye position) and is not redistributed with the asset.

referenceGradeRationale: Lateral photographs are plentiful and the FishBase description gives body depth 1.4 to 1.75 in SL, used to set the fable-v2 disc at 57 percent of SL with a distinct snout; dorsal/frontal proportions (lateral width, snout taper) are inferred from Zebrasoma descriptions rather than calibrated top/front views.
